Knowing is not the same as doing.

Most of us know packaging should be recycled. But after consumption, what happens next comes down to one small moment: the packaging can be retained, returned, discarded, or simply forgotten.

That moment can decide whether material moves back into the recovery system or ends up in landfill.

This is where a Deposit Refund Scheme (DRS) offers a different way of thinking about behaviour. Instead of relying only on awareness, it builds a system around the choice. The return becomes a defined action, participation becomes repeatable, and the behaviour has a tangible outcome.

The challenge is not always convincing people that recycling matters. Sometimes, it is creating the conditions that help them act on what they already know.

Swipe through to see how.
